Messages.Author: Ashenbach
Messages.Body:
Hello, one question:

Is there a window of time to use heidelberg to move the blood gained
with abactor to another vampire, before the blood hunt referendum
kicks in?

Relevant text:

Abactor
[Action] Action
+1 stealth hunt action.
Gain 5 blood. After successful resolution, a referendum is called to
call a blood hunt on this vampire (independent of the action, just as
if he or she had committed diablerie).

Heidelberg Castle, Germany
Master
[2 Pool]
Master: unique location.
Tap to move blood, equipment cards and/or retainers between any two
ready vampires you control. (You choose the amount of blood you move
and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.

Thanks in advance

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ashenbach wrote:
> Hello, one question:
>
> Is there a window of time to use heidelberg to move the blood gained
> with abactor to another vampire, before the blood hunt referendum
> kicks in?

No. The Castle cannot be used until after the action is over. The referendum is
conducted before the action is over, albeit independently of the action.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/ec4be97e6f053648
